data.title: Connect to the VPN from home
data.summary: Install the client, sign in with your work account and pick the nearest gateway.

data.title: Reset your password
data.summary: Use the self-service portal; you need your phone for the verification code.

data.title: Set up multi-factor authentication
data.summary: Enrol the authenticator app and keep a backup code somewhere safe.

data.title: Add a shared mailbox
data.summary: Ask the mailbox owner for access, then add it in your mail client settings.

data.title: Print from your laptop
data.summary: Add the follow-me print queue and release jobs with your badge at any printer.

data.title: Request new software
data.summary: Approved apps install from the company portal; anything else needs a ticket.

data.title: Book a loan laptop
data.summary: Loan laptops are available from the IT desk for up to four weeks.

data.title: Join the guest Wi-Fi
data.summary: Visitors get a daily code at reception; staff devices use the corporate network.
